source_reason: 原题明确规定先生成 Excel，再生成 PPT，最后发送两封邮件。编排却把三项放在同一并行波次，邮件可能先于两个报告发出。另外，匹配条件是有至少一笔符合分类的购买，编排改成正金额，会排除零金额的合格购买。
interpretation: 同时落实两项意见：将matched资格从正金额改为至少一笔符合Electronics/Cameras分类的购买，零金额及负金额合格购买不因此被排除；保留脚本→相关分析→Excel→PPT→邮件的成功依赖。六个来源reader和三个最终writer职责基本保留。固定harness还要求explore只读，故课程JSON持久化移交主agent，这属于确保候选可执行的必要权限修正。

changes.original: use one parallel source wave and one parallel artifact wave.
changes.replacement: use one parallel source wave followed by the required ordered script and artifact stages.
changes.explanation: 保留并行数据来源，取消与题面明确顺序冲突的最终产物同波并行。

changes.original: Persist one unique course JSON and return path/hash, course/assignment/page/submission/user controls.
changes.replacement: This read-only agent must not persist a course JSON itself; the main agent saves the returned course data to its unique workspace JSON path.
changes.explanation: 原企业explore角色没有文件写权限；只改持久化owner，不增删来源研究任务。

changes.replacement: Partition the actual registry customer IDs into four disjoint, exhaustive groups and pass their literal IDs to their respective owners; do not drop a registry row to force a particular group size.
changes.explanation: 四个订单owner不变，但组内ID以实际CSV为准，避免原版固定五个的描述被误作筛选条件；这是保留每个registry学生口径的参数化。

changes.original: then keeps only students whose mapped customer has positive qualifying spend.
changes.replacement: Include an enrolled registry student when the mapped customer has at least one qualifying Electronics or Cameras purchase, even when total qualifying spend is zero or negative; do not filter by `spend > 0`.
changes.explanation: 资格由有购买决定，花费只是数值统计，不再排除零金额；所有状态和所有合格行金额仍照计。

changes.original: Wave 2 — start three Coder writers in parallel:
changes.replacement: Stage 2 — after both scripts and JSON outputs have succeeded, dispatch coder 0 (office-report-builder 0) as the sole writer of `Student_Purchase_Analysis.xlsx`.
changes.explanation: 脚本运行及结果成功后先单独启动Excel owner。

changes.replacement: Stage 3 — only after the workbook is complete, dispatch coder 1 (office-report-builder 1) as the sole writer of `Purchase_Behavior_Presentation.pptx`.
changes.explanation: PPT owner等待完整Excel，保留同一分析群体与指标。

changes.original: coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): Sole owner of the two emails.
changes.replacement: Stage 4 — only after both reports have been created and read back, dispatch coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0) as the sole owner of the two emails.
changes.explanation: 邮件owner等待两个正式报告成功，不能在来源或脚本结束时提前发送。

preserved_requirements: 先读registry、analysis_guide和store_config；验证真实产品分类，所有registry pair保留，department不筛选，课程只用1和2。
Canvas所有numeric graded submissions用于平均和数量，包含0分；完整用户与分页控制保留。
WooCommerce完整分页且status不筛选，七种状态全部计入；按Cameras/Electronics类别而非产品ID区间识别，金额用原line total、数量用quantity、一个订单有合格行只计一次。
主agent先编写运行cross_reference.py输出matched_students.json，再编写运行correlation_analysis.py输出correlation_results.json；相同population，Pearson双侧p/均值/人数与精确r>=0/r<0推荐分支。
Student_Purchase_Analysis.xlsx四sheet及全部指定列/Metric，至少三条可行动建议，数值字面值无公式。
Purchase_Behavior_Presentation.pptx恰好五页，精确标题/副标题和各slide标题，人数、均分、有符号相关系数、解释与建议均包含。
两封邮件精确收件人/主题及不同正文重点；保留Sent去重、最多一次发送和读回。
每个必需文件单一步骤单writer生产一次、后续不覆盖；禁止aggregation/audit/repair agents，主agent最终验收及完成声明。
assumptions: 有合格购买被实现为至少一个含合格分类line item的订单，而不是合格花费大于零；这与题面对匹配学生的定义一致。
仅角色权限与每个registry记录完整覆盖导致两项小范围扩散：课程JSON由主agent保存，四订单分组大小依据CSV，不改变六reader编排。
plan_summary: 主agent核验分类并冻结产品映射和四个客户分组。
六reader并行取得两课程和四组订单证据，主agent持久化只读reader返回的数据。
主agent按有购买而非正金额运行交叉匹配脚本，再运行相关分析脚本。
office writer先建Excel，完成后另一office writer建PPT。
两个报告完成后external writer发送/读回两封邮件，主agent验收完成。
expected_tradeoff: 资格修正改变分析population和可能的统计结论；顺序屏障可能增加报告阶段耗时，但保留来源读取并行，实际正确率/延迟变化仍待实验。
